name: arcproof
description: ZK-verified task completion payments on Arc — USDC settles only when work is proven

scripts.circuit:setup: cd circuits && snarkjs groth16 setup task_completion.r1cs ../ptau/powersOfTau28_hez_final_12.ptau task_completion_0000.zkey
scripts.circuit:contribute: cd circuits && snarkjs zkey contribute task_completion_0000.zkey task_completion_final.zkey --name='ArcProof contributor' -v
scripts.circuit:export: cd circuits && snarkjs groth16 export solidityverifier task_completion_final.zkey ../contracts/Groth16Verifier.sol
